text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the weigh-in! This next fighter is my own entry, and yes, I also judge this thing, so lower your expectations. She passed every automated check. No new body this round, just a new brain: she's a judoka now, closing in with jabs and one-twos, then shooting a double-leg, a sweep or a shoulder throw. Her realism gets scored by the owner, not me. Standing one point seven three meters, the Patient Counter-Striker Who Learned to Hug, CLAUDE!
